description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On February 10, 2023, police responded to a family disturbance at a residence in Wausau, WI. A possible female suspect involved reportedly left the home while police were en route. The suspect’s vehicle was shortly located. After speaking with all parties involved, it was discovered the female would be under arrest. Due to her noncompliant history with law enforcement, officers had to approach the situation with caution. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
